gen-nixie-one-gf-lexend-tera: Thin, retro-tech lines up top, drawn with one steady stroke. Lexend Tera follows in sans-serif, wide-spaced and tall, so give it a bit more size than you think it needs.
gen-nixie-one-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta reads wide and approachable, its tall little letters spaced out like a slow stroll. Lexend Zetta against Nixie One's moderate lowercase makes the clearest difference: one stands tall, the other stays low.
gen-nixie-one-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates packs its tall chalk-board lowercase close to the capital line, with round letters that feel contemporary. And Nixie One's thin retro heading gives way to a body that would keep a long page moving steadily.
gen-nixie-one-source-serif-4: Nixie One draws every letter as if with a single marker, nostalgic and open. Source Serif 4 does the opposite, with a quiet tightening at curve tops that gives paragraphs a dignified, bookish texture.
gen-nosifer-archivo: Archivo opens its curves outward and carries a commanding x-height, editorial but approachable beside Nosifer's pinched, closed letters. A longer passage would move along easily.
gen-nosifer-fs-asap: Asap keeps its body height close to the capitals, with open arcs on its c forms. But if Nosifer were made small, those pinched, crayon-thick mouths would clog up fast.
gen-nosifer-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Dark and commanding, Nosifer arrives with tall crayon-thick strokes. Be Vietnam Pro answers with curve endings that never crowd each other, a set-high mean line and sans lines like bent steel rod, so the closed, pinched heading gets a body that stays open.
gen-nosifer-fs-epilogue: Nosifer hits first, dark and widely tracked, with pinched mouths. Epilogue is a plain sans with a wire-like monoline skeleton and curvy, tall-bodied letters, though a small Nosifer would lose its crayon-thick menace.
gen-nosifer-fs-fira-sans: Nosifer sprawls in a dark, widely tracked rhythm, its pinched mouths shut tight. Fira Sans draws a ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line with s curves open at both ends, so a longer passage would feel roomy and clear.
gen-nosifer-fs-merriweather-sans: Pinched mouths like a sealed envelope flap make Nosifer unmistakable, dark and commanding. Merriweather Sans has tall lowercase that makes words look sturdy, and if the body went large, it would still stay open where the heading is shut.
